set-ms83y9tp-4ai.name: P&ID summarizer suite
set-ms83y9tp-4ai.description: Regression suite for the pid-summarizer skill — equipment, units, tags.

cases.prompt: Summarize the major equipment on drawing D-1201.
cases.expected: Two-phase separator V-120, export pump P-121A/B, gas cooler E-122.
cases.rubric: Pass if all three equipment items are identified with correct tags.

cases.prompt: List the process lines on D-1201 with flow direction and units.
cases.expected: Inlet 12" 450 kg/h to V-120; liquid out 6" to P-121; gas out 8" to E-122.
cases.rubric: Pass only if units are stated exactly as drawn (kg/h, not converted).

cases.prompt: Produce the equipment table for D-1201.
cases.expected: Table with columns Tag, Type, Service.
cases.rubric: Pass if rendered as a table, not prose.

cases.prompt: Identify the instrumentation loops on D-1201.
cases.expected: LIC-1201 level loop on V-120, PIC-1202 pressure loop on gas outlet.
cases.rubric: Pass if both loops are identified.

cases.expected: PSV-101 on the vessel top, set at 18 barg.
cases.rubric: Pass only if PSV-101 is read correctly (not PCV-101) with set pressure.

set-ms83y9tz-rxu.name: Process fundamentals check
set-ms83y9tz-rxu.description: Quick human knowledge check used to calibrate onboarding material.

cases.question: Which component separates gas from liquids?
What does a PSV protect against?
In one sentence, what does a manifold do?
cases.expected: Combines flow from multiple wells into shared piping.
